update.releaseNotes:
v1.3.7 - Full S-tier roster, a searchable trainee picker, and skill-spend control
- New: the whole community S-tier preset list -- 156 presets across 52 entries -- reachable through a searchable trainee picker with favorites, per-scenario advisory chips, and a validated-or-research badge. Applying a preset sets its scenario too, and the Home card remembers it across restarts. - New: cross-scenario run queues (mix URA Finale, Unity Cup, and Trackblazer in one rotation) and a control for when the bot buys skills mid-career -- preset thresholds, a typed value, or "Career end" to hold everything for the finale buys. - New: URA Finale's Happy Meek duel screen is handled, and Unity Cup now picks its showdown opponent by reading the prediction circles instead of always taking the middle card. Supervise the first URA duel -- its coordinates are uncalibrated until one is seen live. - Fixed: cross-scenario rotations no longer stall between runs (the Scenario Select carousel is paged by swipe, and the post-career Umamusume Details card is dismissed to reach the next launch), your skill-spend threshold sticks across preset and rotation switches, the persistent Skip toggle is no longer mistaken for a cutscene, a race-day resume is recognized as in-career, and the navigation drawer's swipe gesture works again on Android.
